def transform(grid):
    """Mark positions where corresponding cells in the two panels match."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_dividers = [r for r in range(1, h - 1) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    if row_dividers:
        divider = row_dividers[0]
        first, second = grid[:divider], grid[divider + 1:]
        shared = {v for row in first for v in row} & {v for row in second for v in row}
        base = next(iter(shared))
        return [[3 if first[r][c] == second[r][c] == base else base
                 for c in range(w)] for r in range(len(first))]
    col_dividers = [c for c in range(1, w - 1) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))]
    divider = col_dividers[0]
    first = [row[:divider] for row in grid]
    second = [row[divider + 1:] for row in grid]
    shared = {v for row in first for v in row} & {v for row in second for v in row}
    base = next(iter(shared))
    return [[3 if first[r][c] == second[r][c] == base else base
             for c in range(len(first[0]))] for r in range(h)]

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
    # find full-height uniform separator column
    div=next(c for c in range(w) if all(row[c]==grid[0][c] for row in grid) and len({row[c] for row in grid})==1)
    left=[row[:div] for row in grid]
    right=[row[div+1:] for row in grid]
    left_bg=Counter(v for row in left for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    right_bg=Counter(v for row in right for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[3 if left[r][c]==left_bg and right[r][c]!=right_bg else left_bg for c in range(len(left[0]))] for r in range(h)]
